data.source: data2/mightee2025_rar_digitized_points.csv (G099 vector extraction, validated vs the paper's residual panel, rms 0.036 dex)

fit.form: g_obs^2 = g_N^2 + a0 g_N, a0 free (unweighted OLS, dex)

systematics.b_pressure: not applied (paper: negligible, Iorio+17/Pavel+21); direction anti-closing, 0.003-0.02 dex

c_inclination.note: committed q0/G-R checks exclude a coherent bias; scatter only

d_beam_smearing.note: 3D Barolo beam-convolved + <5 arcsec discarded; residual anti-directional

verdicts.V1: V1 a0_MIGHTEE = (1.843e-10 +- 2.42e-11) m/s^2 (quadratic RAR, a0 free, 80 rings; log10 scale -9.734 +- 0.057 dex); the same rings under the paper's own MLS form with full MNR errors give 1.69 +- 0.13e-10 (within 0.6 sigma of this fit) -- the deep end's scale is interpolator-insensitive at ~1.7-1.9e-10, and with a0 FREE the rms drops from the DE-anchored 0.190 to 0.129 dex (the SPARC benchmark 0.13-0.15): the MIGHTEE amplitude excess was normalization, not shape.
verdicts.V2: V2 systematics: (a) Ystar/IMF abscissa is the ONLY real closer (0 -> +0.097 dex by the paper's own refits; the SPARC-class fixed-M/L point lands a0 at ~1.08e-10, i.e. the MIGHTEE deep end CAN be marched onto/just under the SPARC band but NOT onto the DE anchor); (b) pressure wrong sign, negligible (the paper applies NO correction: 'negligible for the high rotational velocities'); (c) inclination scatter only -- closure would need a coherent ~10-deg i overestimate the committed q0/G-R checks exclude; (d) beam smearing already corrected (3D Barolo beam-convolution) and any residual acts anti-directional.  CHECK: NO committed systematic closes the 0.137-dex offset (max honest closure 0.097); the offset's systematic FLOOR is the RAR scale, its fiducial size is a full a0-scale step above the DE anchor.
verdicts.V3: V3 honest: the deep end PREFERS a0 = 1.843e-10 +- 2.42e-11 (paper MLS 1.69e-10 +- 1.30e-11), i.e. 1.97x the DE anchor (+5.2 sigma, log; deep-end +0.147 dex) and 1.48x the top of the committed RAR band (+3.0 sigma, log; deep-end +0.085 dex).  The footing tension's third data point: DE-anchored 0.936e-10 < SPARC-RAR 1.20-1.246e-10 < MIGHTEE-deep 1.69-1.84e-10 -- a MONOTONE staircase, MIGHTEE the top step, and the MIGHTEE-vs-SPARC gap (1.48x) is itself a mass-to-light-normalisation question (a fixed-0.6 M/L marches it onto/below the SPARC band), while the MIGHTEE-and-SPARC vs DE gap (1.28-1.97x) survives every committed systematic.  The deep end says: the a0 scale is RAR-class, not DE-class; the 0.137-dex offset is a real a0-scale difference, not an observational artifact.
